draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Chikmagalur! This is where coffee was first grown in India, and the hills around you are still covered in plantations. Karnataka's highest peak, Mullayanagiri, is in this district too.
draft.hungryLine: Masala dosa is the move here, and Town Canteen's is so good people say it can beat Vidyarthi Bhavan in Bengaluru.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Take the minibus up to B.B.Hills for big views, or head about 30 km out to the Veera Narayana Temple at Belavadi.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Do the 5 km Chikmagalur Walk from the checkpost on Kadur road out to Aldur village, past very scenic countryside.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Chikmagalur district was called Kadur district until 1947.

spots.name: B.B.Hills
spots.detail: Minibus from the private bus stand · Bababudangiri's terrific hill views

spots.name: Veera Narayana Temple
spots.detail: 30 km away · Well-known temple in Belavadi village

spots.name: Amrutapura Temple
spots.detail: 67 km away · Village temple north of Chikmagalur

tips.title: Plan the B.B.Hills bus.
tips.body: The minibus leaves the private bus stand around 12:30PM and heads back by 5PM, so you only get about an hour up top.

tips.title: Carry snacks to the hills.
tips.body: There's only one tea shop at B.B.Hills, so don't count on a proper meal up there.

story.title: River source
story.body: Chikmagalur's hills are part of the Western Ghats in the Malnad region. The Tunga and Bhadra rivers start here.

story.title: India's first coffee
story.body: Coffee was first cultivated in India right here in Chikmagalur. It's still famous for its coffee plantations.

story.title: Kadur district
story.body: The district went by the name Kadur, or Cuddoor, until 1947. Today its official name is Chikkamagaluru.

story.title: Hills and treks
story.body: Visitors come for the Bababudan Giri ranges, Mullayanagiri, camping, kayaking and trekking. The Sringeri Mutt in the district is also a big pilgrim draw.
